column1: # id camera chi shim stdcpp sdk gpu_layout power dsp_policy
# gpu_layout is an id in gpu-layouts.tsv, never a hash and never a wildcard.
# power=optional_lineage may try the measured helper. Any other token skips it.
# dsp_policy is INFORMATIONAL ONLY. It never selects or gates the staged rule.
#   measured = the three allows were device-measured on the current phone.
#   stack    = the same F.14 camera stack is mounted, so the same requirement
#              set applies. Whether THIS ROM's live policy can express those
#              grants is decided at install by root-preflight policy-capability.
# The column is not evidence that DSP works, and a retained sepolicy.cil is
# not sufficient to claim feature compatibility.
